Aisha (People Ops): FYI — new two-step calibration flow for this review cycle. First: org-level micro-calibrations next week. Second: cross-org final calibration the week after. Please read and sign up. :clipboard:
Ben (People Ops): Signup sheet + facilitator slots here: https://rwd.co/sheets/calib-1739 — add your name and preferred timezone. We need at least 2 managers per session.
Emily M: Quick Q — are ICs allowed to observe micro-calibrations or is it manager-only?
Aisha (People Ops): Manager-only for micro-calibrations. We’ll open a 30min post-calibration readout for ICs who want transparency.
Lana R: Heads up — two of my managers are OOO Wed-Thu. Can we request a backfill?
Ben (People Ops): Yes — use the backfill column on the sheet. If you can't find a manager, tag @people-ops and we’ll assign a floating reviewer.
Mike T: Is there a template for the calibration notes / rationale we should attach to the review form?
Aisha (People Ops): Yes, use the tiny template attached in the sheet or paste this snippet in your review comments block:
```
Calibration rationale (short):
- Evidence: 1-2 bullets
- Relative level vs rubric
- Recommended outcome (promo/no-promo/needs development)
```
Ben (People Ops): Also: flag conflicts of interest in the sheet (e.g., direct report of reviewer, hiring panel overlap). We’ll reassign.
Emily M: What about contractors and conversions? Do they follow the same rubric?
Aisha (People Ops): Contractors get a tailored slide in the micro-calib (criteria: deliverables + ramp). Conversion recommendations should be discussed in org micro-calib then elevated to cross-org for bandwidth check.
Lana R: Any embargo dates? Don't want reviewers posting feedback publicly before approvals.
Ben (People Ops): Embargo until cross-org calibration closes: DO NOT publish final ratings before 2026-04-02 23:59 UTC. Draft comments in private only.
CalBot: Reminder scheduled: micro-calibration sessions start in 48h — check your slot in https://rwd.co/sheets/calib-1739 :bell:
Mike T: If someone can't make either phase, what's the SLA for handing off reviews?
Aisha (People Ops): Please reassign 72h before your session. If that's impossible, escalate to @people-ops with the manager name + affected reviews and we'll cover.
Emily M: Thanks — adding my managers now.
Ben (People Ops): Thanks all — we’ll post the facilitator guide and short 8-slide deck in #docs after the first run. Ping us if you need synchronous help. :pray:
